caption: Enemy-contact distance check skips the square root for pairs that are unambiguously out of contact (#1255). This clash is the code path that change touches -- a Shield Wall Infantry regiment (28) held by a larger attacking Infantry regiment (40) locking front-to-front around tick 220, so every tick afterwards runs the contact accumulation over a dense candidate set. The battle it records is bit-identical to main's: state dumps at 16 ticks between 60 and 740, plus the per-tick hash stream, come back 17/17 byte-identical against main (340815 bytes on each side), while the same comparison against the pre-fix commit differs in 3 of those files. Nothing in this clip should look different from main -- that is the claim being made.
